notes: Not approved and not published. The owner approves every post (npm run approve) after seeing the render and every caption.

Facts: level 1-2 EASY, 3-5 MEDIUM (stored NORMAL), 6-9 HARD, 10 and up ADVANCED; own side counts in full, the other side at half (data/athleteLevel.js). That is why the cards say "Fit level 1" and "Fit level 10": the Level 10 clip athlete is mostly Fit XP (about 4,960). A level 10 made mostly of Fight XP would open lower on Quick Mission, so never write plain "level 10 = ADVANCED".
The pick in ADJUST lasts for the visit only; the page says "for today" and so does this script. No "unlock" wording (the app has no lock).
AT YOUR LEVEL block (lvl3-level-page ~9 s) shows a COMBO COACH row at the athlete's Fight level: check that frame does not contradict the Quick Mission line before using it.
